messages:
nina: Heads-up: PM asked for a safer v1->v2 fade strategy after a handful of billing complaints. want a short proposal here.
omar: We should avoid any behavior that inflates "migration spikes" alerts. tagging traffic that stays on v1 for policy reasons seems easiest.
raj: Agreed. Proposal: 'soft-fade' policy with three levers: (1) compat-tag header, (2) soft quota caps, (3) global throttle.
maya: For telemetry, add header X-Redwood-Compat: soft-fade and ingest as separate dimension. Exclude those tokens from the "migration spike" alert pipeline but keep them in migration progress metrics.
sara: Console needs both tenant-facing copy and an internal row. Internal row should show applied_by, expiry, reason, and a revoke button for CS.
omar: Router change minimal: insert soft-fade check before fallback. pseudocode: if pin->v1; else if header==v2->v2; else if soft_fade(tenant)->v1 + inject header; else -> v2. Keep idempotent.
raj: Quotas: soft-fade tenants get a configurable cap (default 25% of standard per-tenant quota). Enforced in quota layer so it applies across runtimes. Exposed in console.
maya: Sampling plan: 100% sample of soft-fade traffic for 48h, then 5%. Key signals: token-delta, latency, v1-util. Alerts: billing-delta > 20% OR v1-util > 65% => page SRE.
sara: UX owners: I'll add internal banner + revoke. PM wants default window 21 days for SMBs.
deploy-bot: Router + header + telemetry flag PR created. Staging smoke passed. Canary 2024-08-01 13:00 UTC at 3% behind feature flag soft-fade.
nina: Owners: router=omar, telemetry=maya, console=sara, quotas=raj. I'll draft runbook and post link. Any objections?
raj: none. just make sure quota caps are tweakable per-rollout.
maya: will wire alerts and dashboard panels pre-canary.
omar: gonna land router behind feature flag and add tenant-check cache. PR link incoming.
sara: will mock banner + revoke modal and sync with CS docs.
nina: thanks, team. aim to have runbook + legal-approved copy before canary.
